Ami (AE): Cerulean CISO paused the POC. Blocking asks: (1) BYO-KMS + attestation, (2) named demo SLA (p95), (3) IP allowlist + ops contact. They want a concrete start date next Tue. Need exec alignment today. @Diego @Pri :warning:
Diego (Solutions): Quick summary: Fast path = Dedicated + temporary managed-KMS + IP allowlist — demo in ~3 business days. Full BYO-KMS + attestation for Private will be ~10 business days. Recommend a phased plan: demo first, swap to BYO mid-pilot with a documented swap date.
Pri (Eng-Infra): Connector notes: container agent + mTLS + HSM handshake. ETA: 7-9bd to harden + smoke tests; BYO-KMS handshake + key rotation tests add ~2bd. If they accept managed-KMS for demo with guaranteed swap, we can meet their window.
Hannah (Legal): I'll draft BYO-KMS clause and one-page attestation addendum. Need the customer's security questionnaire. ETA for draft: EOD tomorrow.
ops-bot: Ops note: egress peering requires ASN + IP ranges. Ops owner assigned: Casey.
sec-bot: Reminder: include audit log retention and encryption-in-transit details for questionnaire answers.
Ami (AE): Customer asked for a demo SLA: p95 < 450ms for short-chat flows and a fallback rule to switch to an int8 model if SLA breached twice in a row. Diego 1: Can you include expected token cost delta for fallback models?
Diego (Solutions): Yes 1 I'll prepare a 1-pager with three options (fast demo, full private, hybrid) + cost delta table + SLA/fallback rules. Targeting 2:30pm PT exec sync.
Pri (Eng-Infra): I'll run a brief feasibility spike and post a short runbook snippet for fallback config before 1:45pm PT. Example:
```
fallback_trigger: p95_ms > 450 for 2 windows
action: switch_model rwd-small-int8
```
Hannah (Legal): ACK. I'll attach a questionnaire mapping skeleton and SOC2 evidence links when ready.
Ami (AE): Action items: 1) Diego one-pager (costs + SLA) before sync, 2) Pri connector ETA + runbook by 1:45pm, 3) Hannah BYO-KMS draft EOD tomorrow, 4) Ops to request ASN/IPs from Cerulean. Scheduling 20-min exec sync at 2:30pm PT. Please keep updates in-thread only. :lock:
